structured_output.what_is_happening: $facet is a pump.fun coin created about 01:07 before detection that moved to PumpSwap about 15 minutes after launch. It is tied to "FACET" (usefacet.io), a web app where five AI models review the same code, documents or images as one panel. The project's X account @usefacetio used to be called @FacetSOL, which points to a Solana-token angle from the start. At detection the coin was about 44 minutes old with a $78k market cap, $23.8k liquidity and roughly $101k of volume in 1 hour (4.3x turnover). Price was up 43% in 5 minutes, but GeckoTerminal already showed -9.5% in its latest 5 minutes. The all-time-high market cap is about $104k. The creator has sold out (dev holds 0%) and GMGN flags it as a community takeover.

narrative.description: A small AI-tool coin tied to a working product: a multi-model AI review panel on usefacet.io. It is a common 'dev ships an app, launches a coin' format. I found no news, no traction and no outside coverage of the product.
narrative.why_spreading: Most likely early trading bots and degens around migration, plus the product link. I could find no organic posts on X, Reddit or news.

token_connection.why_this_token: The website and the @usefacetio X account are linked on its DexScreener/GMGN profile. It is the only same-name token with liquidity and volume. The X account's old name, FacetSOL, suggests the account was set up with a token in mind.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Six other facet/facetdefi tokens, all dead at about $3.3k market cap with no liquidity. Two 'facetdefi' tokens were created about 19 hours earlier, and several 'facet' clones appeared in the 30 minutes before this one.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 95 bundler wallets and 36 snipers among 183 holders, a bot/degen rate of 64% and 134 fresh wallets. On the other side: 12 smart wallets and 1 renowned wallet, no paid DexScreener boosts or ads, and top-10 holders at only 21.8%. The creator dumped out (creator_close) and the dev's X account has launched 2 tokens. I found no organic social posts.
authenticity.uncertainty: X is barely indexed by search engines, so organic posting may exist that I could not see.

structural_risks: The dev has exited, so the project may be abandoned (community-takeover flag)
Heavy bundler and bot share, so volume may be flipping between bots
Price is already 25% below the ATH and the latest 5-minute candle is negative
Liquidity is only $23.7k, so the price can swing sharply
The dev's X account has launched 2 tokens, which suggests a serial launcher

structured_output.counterargument: A real, working AI product with a clean structure (LP burned, mint and freeze renounced, spread-out holders, no paid promotion) and 12 smart wallets could draw AI-narrative buyers after migration. A move from $77k to $155k is only a doubling, which happens often at this size.
unknowns: Whether the X account has real followers or any engagement
Whether the dev will keep supporting the coin after selling
Whether any call channels are pushing it

source_coverage.notes: Searches for the contract address returned nothing. The site describes a five-model AI review panel and does not mention a token. Searches for the X handles returned nothing relevant.

structured_output.thesis: A 'dev launches a coin for an AI app' play where the dev has already sold out. Trading is dominated by bundlers and bots, the price is already past a local peak, and I found no organic attention. The clean structure keeps a rug unlikely, but the odds of a quick 2x are below average-to-average.
